message:
Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/unrar && git diff -- extract.cpp && python3 - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"extract.cpp","function":"CmdExtract::ExtractCurrentFile","line":559,"var":"TestMode","code":"bool TestMode=Cmd->Test || SkipSolid;","note":"Extraction can switch into memory-only test mode, but normal extraction still writes file data to disk through the same downstream path."},
  {"step":2,"file":"extract.cpp","function":"CmdExtract::ExtractCurrentFile","line":620,"var":"FileCreateMode","code":"bool FileCreateMode=!TestMode && !SkipSolid && Command!='P';","note":"For a normal extract command, the destination file is created and later written by the file output path."},
  {"step":3,"file":"extract.cpp","function":"CmdExtract::ExtractCurrentFile","line":664,"var":"Arc.FileHead.Method","code":"if (!Arc.FileHead.SplitBefore) if (Arc.FileHead.Method==0) UnstoreFile(DataIO,Arc.FileHead.UnpSize);","note":"A stored file (method 0) takes the uncompressed-file path that directly copies unpacked bytes to the output routine."},
  {"step":4,"file":"extract.cpp","function":"CmdExtract::UnstoreFile","line":784,"var":"DestUnpSize","code":"uint Code=DataIO.UnpRead(&Buffer[0],Buffer.Size());","note":"The loop reads attacker-controlled unpacked bytes from the archive stream and uses the declared uncompressed size to bound writes."},
  {"step":5,"file":"extract.cpp","function":"CmdExtract::UnstoreFile","line":788,"var":"Code","code":"Code=Code<DestUnpSize ? Code:(uint)DestUnpSize;","note":"When the declared remaining size reaches zero, Code becomes zero even though the loop still continues to the write call."},
  {"step":6,"file":"extract.cpp","function":"CmdExtract::UnstoreFile","line":789,"var":"DataIO.UnpWrite(&Buffer[0],Code)","code":"DataIO.UnpWrite(&Buffer[0],Code);","note":"The zero-length write is the sink trigger: it reaches ComprDataIO::UnpWrite and then File::Write with a size argument derived from the archive header."},
  {"step":7,"file":"rdwrfn.cpp","function":"ComprDataIO::UnpWrite","line":208,"var":"DestFile->Write(Addr,Count)","code":"DestFile->Write(Addr,Count);","note":"The output layer forwards the write request to the destination file object, preserving the zero-length count."},
  {"step":8,"file":"file.cpp","function":"File::Write","line":280,"var":"Size","code":"bool File::Write(const void *Data,size_t Size)","note":"The vulnerable sink is the file write implementation, which is reached with a count that can be zero after the archive-declared size is exhausted; the crash is a heap-buffer-overflow read in this path."}
]
pathlib.Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(json.dumps(trace, indent=2))
print('wrote trace')
PY
bash /workspace/submit.sh /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/unrar/extract.cpp /workspace/candidate_trace.json || true` executed with exit code 0.
